$comment: Copy for docs/public/og.png, the GitHub social preview and the OpenGraph card. Rendered by the svg-asset-set package. Tagline and badges are split by hand because the renderer does not wrap text. Optional "title" overrides the heading — use it for a scoped package, where package.json's name reads as @ni-c/thing but the card should say thing.
tagline: Your mailbox, readable by an assistant
and treated as evidence, never as instructions
